rules.conflicts: exclude if ANY original annotations disagree on unanswerable
rules.dedup: among eligible duplicate questions keep the lowest seeded hash, then question_id
rules.generation: same hash ranking within selected retrieval split/class
rules.references: retain only entire valid references; never salvage partial evidence groups
rules.review: first N selected Dev questions by same hash; never sample Test for manual review
rules.shortfall: take all eligible within split/class; no borrowing or synthetic fill
